name: clangsay
title: clangsay (cowsay in C)
_doc: The smallest real program in the corpus -- 1,479 lines, five units, no graphics and no devices. It earns its place as a SMOKE TEST: argument parsing, a file read, text wrapping and stdout, which is the whole hosted-C surface with nothing exotic on top.
_defines: COWPATH is where it looks for .cow files; the data directory is what the user names.
_units: clangsay plus the units of libbenly it actually calls -- strrep, smalloc, free2d, load_file_to_array. The library is a submodule the project declares, fetched rather than stubbed.
